name: Bambu Lab A1 mini (estimated stock parts; published gantry clearance)
provenance: UNCALIBRATED estimated stock A1-series parts, nozzle tip at z=0 (+X right, +Y rear, +Z up; mm). https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/a1-mini/maintenance/toolhead and https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/a1/manual/faq identify shared A1/A1-mini hotend, covers and fans; they do NOT publish nozzle-referenced dimensions. The community mockup https://www.printables.com/model/685475 has an oversized tip (reach 1.06..1.78 mm at z=0); its near-tip sections are discarded, not shifted upward as if calibrated. Its outer widths only inform the estimated housing/carriage spans. Component Z bounds are author estimates: land 0..0.05, cone 0.05..3, sock 3..19, heater 4..18, ducts/housing 5..20/50, fan 18..45, carriage 35..80. No body part reaches tip height. External land radius 0.3 mm follows the community X1/P1 Hotend.STEP tip section (https://www.printables.com/model/533213); using it for A1 and a 35-degree cone is explicitly estimated, not A1 CAD. The 0.4 mm bore is not the external land diameter. Finite cone bands avoid importing the next section into z=0 or extruding each section to z=80. BambuStudio presets publish gantry lower height 25 mm and farther horizontal edge 56.5 mm: https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/tree/47a13eeb1d9af65ef2371e361c856e21d4f6ca72/resources/profiles/BBL/machine . Beam Y span -56.5..56.5 and top 100 mm remain conservative assumptions; infinite X. 1 mm body vertical/lateral margins; no inflation of nozzle contact geometry. Tip allowance 3 mm/1 mm. No smaller mini housing is established. All housing heights need hardware measurement; estimates and margins are not a calibrated collision guarantee. Corrected after planar z0.00_* collision report, 2026-10-10.
